capabilities: Resurface notes one at a time in a scrollable card feed
Bookmark notes from the feed for later
Switch between a list view and the feed view
extras: Install is manual: clone the repo into .obsidian/plugins, install dependencies and build; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. A 'planned' section lists unfinished ideas (curated feeds, richer note-type visuals).
intentEvidence: its the same brain underneath by @yaroshevych, but with my own take on how it looks and feels
motivation: The author saw the Doomscroll plugin on Reddit, had wanted to build something similar, and extended it with his own visual take and extra polish.
problem: Obsidian gives no engaging way to browse back through old notes; they sit forgotten unless you search for them.

relations.evidence: i stumbled on a little Obsidian plugin called Doomscroll by @yaroshevych, on Reddit

summary: Feed-style view that resurfaces your notes one at a time in a scrollable paper-card interface, with bookmarks and a list mode.
